findings.detail: Same problem as the earlier questions M2-S40-T1 and M3-S50-T2. All three ask which kind of task gets direct execution, and the same reasoning gives the answer: a simple, well-scoped change goes to direct execution. Framing it as a workflow rule does not change the choice. Correct option C even reuses the scene of M2-S40-T1 (a single validation check in one function). Two wrong options repeat M3-S50-T2: option A (several valid approaches, like the choice between infrastructure approaches) and option D (library migration touching 45+ files). Only one wrong option may repeat.

blind_answer.reason: Direct execution is the right choice for simple, well-scoped changes, such as adding one validation check to one function. Plan mode suits tasks with multiple valid approaches or large multi-file migrations, which rules out A and D. A close deadline (B) is not a good criterion, because skipping planning on complex work risks costly rework.
